items.headline: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.
items.action: Apply the vendor's fix or mitigation before the CISA KEV due date (2026-11-23); if no fix exists, isolate or discontinue the affected product.

compensating_controls: Restrict management and admin interfaces to a dedicated admin network or VPN; block them from the internet
Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative access where the product supports it
Rotate admin credentials and API keys, and remove unknown admin accounts
remediation.verify: Review admin and auth logs since the disclosure date for logins without a matching MFA or SSO event

items.headline: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.
items.action: Apply the vendor's fix or mitigation before the CISA KEV due date (2026-11-23); if no fix exists, isolate or discontinue the affected product.

compensating_controls: Restrict the device's management interface to an admin network; check for new admin accounts and config changes
Restrict network access to the affected service to known management hosts
Change any credentials the vendor allows you to change and monitor for logins by built-in accounts
remediation.verify: Search authentication logs for logins by built-in or service accounts from unexpected sources

items.headline: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.summary: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication.
items.action: Apply the vendor's fix or mitigation before the CISA KEV due date (2026-11-23); if no fix exists, isolate or discontinue the affected product.

compensating_controls: Block or filter untrusted network access to the affected endpoint (WAF rule or network ACL)
Run the service with least privilege and no outbound internet access where possible
remediation.verify: Hunt for unexpected child processes spawned by the application server process

items.headline: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
items.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.
items.action: Apply the vendor's fix or mitigation before the CISA KEV due date (2026-11-23); if no fix exists, isolate or discontinue the affected product.

compensating_controls: Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published
remediation.verify: Confirm the installed version on every instance after patching
